如果同一基底能使两者都对角，它们就必须交换。非零交换子排除了共同对角化基底；这个: If one basis diagonalized both matrices, they would commute. A nonzero commutator rules out a common diagonalizing basis over either the real or complex field.

正确。全映到单位矩阵满足每一对乘法，是合法但不忠实的表示。判断表示要看乘法，不能: Correct. Mapping everything to the identity satisfies every product and gives a valid nonfaithful representation. Check multiplication rather than merely counting distinct matrices.

正确。两个反射各自有实对角化基底，但其交换子非零，所以不存在共同对角化基底。: Correct. Both reflections have individual real eigenbases, but their nonzero commutator prevents a common diagonalizing basis.
